summary: Number of response candidates requested from GenerateContent. The Google Gen AI SDK exposes the field on Gemini Developer API and Vertex AI requests, but the image-generation guide warns that Gemini may not follow an exact requested image count.
combines: The current @google/genai GenerateContentConfig exposes candidateCount without a Gemini Developer API exclusion, so the field is available on both documented API surfaces for the reviewed image models.
Google does not publish an image-model-specific maximum for candidateCount.

The image-generation guide says the model may not follow an exact requested output count, so candidateCount cannot provide reliable image fan-out. Lixpi skips it and creates one request per required variant.
